svg.title: The Hephaestus glossary
svg.desc: Genome: like a recipe card sealed in plastic. One exact version of an agent: prompt, model, permissions. Any change makes a new one. Agent: like the dish cooked from the recipe. A Genome actually running on a task. World: like the exam and the exam-hall rules. The tasks, limits, judge, and rules an agent is measured against. Law: like a rule carved in stone. A World rule no agent can change, like “never read the judge.” Arena: like the exam hall. Two Genomes do identical tasks, each sealed in its own sandbox. Evaluator: like a judge behind a curtain. Scores every run. Agents never see it or the answers. Receipt: like a signed scorecard. Proof behind one decision: what ran, what it scored, and why. Ledger: like a notebook with glued-in pages. The permanent record. Each entry is chained to the last, so edits show. Champion: like the title holder. The version trusted as best for a World, until a challenger wins fairly. Freeze: like an emergency brake, on by default. Hephaestus starts paused. Only you can release it, and that is recorded too. Daemon: like the smith at the anvil. hephaestusd: does the work, and is the only writer to the Ledger. Mutation: like one edit to the recipe. A single proposed change, with its reason, waiting to be tested. Descendant: like a new sprout. A Genome made from one or more parents. It records who they were. Generation: like a step down the stairs. How many steps a Genome is from its first ancestor. Lineage: like the family tree. Every related version, and who came from whom. Forge: like the hammer and the workbench. Studies failures, proposes a Mutation, and builds the new version. Promotion: like stepping onto the podium. Replacing the Champion, only when the evidence clears the World's bar. Rollback: like turning back the hourglass. Returning to an earlier Champion, which can always be rebuilt exactly. Gene: like a trick that works in other kitchens. A change that helped in more places than where it was first tried. Gene Bank: like a chest of proven tricks. The collection of Genes and the evidence for each one. Species: like a key cut for one lock. A branch of the family that measurably does best at one kind of task. Drift: like the wind changing. The tasks or conditions have shifted, so old scores may not hold. Canary: like the canary in the coal mine. Roll a new Champion out in stages, and back out automatically if it gets worse. Sandbox: like a locked crate. The macOS isolation every run happens in, cut off from the judge and the record.
